import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

# Disable progress bars to ensure clean execution
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# File paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading training data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")

print("Loading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Prepare features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].copy()
test_id = test_df["Id"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

print(f"Feature columns: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Target classes: {sorted(y.unique())}")

# Train/validation split with genuine hold-out validation (15%)
print("Creating train/validation split (15% hold-out)...")
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

print(f"Train set size: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")

# Train RandomForest classifier with increased n_estimators (350)
print("Training RandomForest classifier (n_estimators=350)...")
n_estimators = 350  # Proven improvement from previous solution
max_depth = None
n_jobs = -1
random_state = RANDOM_STATE

model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=n_estimators,
    max_depth=max_depth,
    n_jobs=n_jobs,
    random_state=random_state,
    verbose=False,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)
print("Training completed.")

# Evaluate on validation set (genuine hold-out)
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
print("Creating submission file...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id.values, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to: {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")

# Print summary
print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Train samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"Validation samples (hold-out): {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Validation Accuracy (multi-class classification): {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Submission file: {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print("=" * 50)
